extracted.name: Snow Grapes
extracted.description: These snow grapes are encased in a sweet creamy dressing for an easy fruit salad. These fruity bites are seedless, ripe, and delicious — yum!
instruction_lines: Remove grapes from stems, rinse, and set aside to dry. Mix together sour cream, cream cheese, white sugar, and vanilla in a large bowl. Fold in grapes until evenly coated. Chill overnight before serving.
